## Functions

### `Toolbar`

```ts
Toolbar(props: ToolbarProps): Html
```

A wrapping row of controls above a list or table.

## Types

### `ToolbarProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | `Html` |  | Controls at the start (search, filters). |
| `end` | `Html` |  | Controls pushed to the end (a primary action, a date range). |
